paper_title: First Results from Axion Haloscope at CAPP around 10.7 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, reconstructed from stated multiples of the KSVZ coupling (g_KSVZ ~ 3.96e-16 GeV^-1 * m_a/ueV)
notes: CAPP-PACE pilot haloscope (IBS, Korea) first results. Two exclusion regions at 90% CL assuming virialized axion line shape and rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3: (1) narrow KSVZ run 10.7126-10.7186 ueV at near-KSVZ sensitivity (~1x KSVZ, g ~ 4.2e-15 GeV^-1), and (2) wide 9KSVZ runs 10.16-11.37 ueV at 8-10x KSVZ coupling (~3.6-4.1e-14 GeV^-1). No numerical table given; coupling values computed from the stated KSVZ multiples using g_KSVZ = (alpha*g_gamma/pi/f_a) with g_gamma = 0.97 and m_a*f_a relation, so values are approximate (~10-20% uncertainty).
